## Repository overview (short)

- This is a small single-page React app generated by Anima and wired with Vite + Tailwind CSS.
- Key runtime: Vite dev server. Build artifacts are produced to `dist/` and deployment is via `gh-pages`.
- Entry point: `src/index.jsx` which renders the `Box` screen (`src/screens/Box/Box.jsx`).

## Quick commands (run from project root)

- Install: `npm install`
- Dev server (local HMR): `npm run dev`  — serves at http://localhost:5173 by default
- Build production bundle: `npm run build`  — output is `dist/`
- Deploy (gh-pages): `npm run deploy` (calls `gh-pages -d dist`)

Files that show these scripts: `package.json`, `vite.config.js`, `tailwind.config.js`.

## Architecture & patterns you should know

- Component organization
  - Reusable UI pieces live under `src/components` (example: `Footer.jsx`).
  - Screen-level UI is under `src/screens/<Name>`; the primary example is `src/screens/Box/`.
  - `src/screens/Box/Box.jsx` composes smaller `components/` in the same folder (Header, HeroSection, etc.).

- Styling
  - Tailwind utility classes are used everywhere (see `tailwind.config.js`).
  - The project uses `tailwindcss` via the PostCSS pipeline configured in `vite.config.js`.

- Asset imports
  - Static images are referenced with `new URL("../../assets/images/...", import.meta.url).toString()` (see `Footer.jsx` and other components). Use this pattern for any runtime-resolvable asset URLs.

- Helper utilities
  - The `cn` utility at `src/lib/utils.js` combines `clsx` + `tailwind-merge`. Use it for conditional class composition to avoid class collisions.

## Conventions & small gotchas (explicit)

- Entry/rendering: `src/index.jsx` mounts the `Box` component. To add a new screen, create `src/screens/YourScreen/YourScreen.jsx` and export it from `src/screens/YourScreen/index.js`, then import + render it from `src/index.jsx` (or wire via router).

- Image handling: Do not use plain relative string paths for images in components — use the `new URL(..., import.meta.url)` pattern to ensure Vite resolves them correctly in dev and build.

- Package.json alias: `package.json` contains an `alias` field mapping `@/*` → `./src/components/ui/$1`, but the project has no Vite alias configured and no imports use `@/` (search returned none). Prefer explicit relative imports until an alias is added to `vite.config.js`.

- Base path: `vite.config.js` sets `base: './'`. The build uses relative paths which matter for static hosting (GH Pages uses this already).

## What to change and where (common tasks)

- Add a new component:
  - Create file under `src/components`, use Tailwind classes and `cn()` from `src/lib/utils.js` for conditional classes.

- Add a new screen:
  - Scaffold `src/screens/MyScreen/MyScreen.jsx` and `index.js` that re-exports it. Update `src/index.jsx` or router to render it.

- Add an image:
  - Put the file in `assets/images/` and import it with `new URL("../../assets/images/name.png", import.meta.url)` in the component that uses it.

## Build, debug, and deploy notes for agents

- Hot reload via `npm run dev` is reliable for front-end changes. Use browser devtools for component and CSS inspection.
- There are no automated tests in the repo (none discovered). Do not add test scaffolding unless requested.
- The `npm run deploy` script runs `gh-pages -d dist` — the repo is already configured to build with `base: './'`, so the site should work as a static deploy.

## Useful file references (examples)

- App entry: `src/index.jsx`
- Main screen example: `src/screens/Box/Box.jsx`, `src/screens/Box/index.js`
- Tailwind config: `tailwind.config.js`
- Vite config (postcss plugin): `vite.config.js`
- Utility: `src/lib/utils.js` (the `cn` helper)
